title: Flavio Bolsonaro’s great escape: Is this the beginning of the end for ‘Bolsonarism’?
summary: The Brazilian election results had barely been announced before the defeated presidential candidate, Flavio Bolsonaro, packed his bags and fled with his family to the United States. The move may have dealt a serious blow to the already tarnished family brand, but does it spell the end for “Bolsonarism”?
